card.name: Just before pushing the plunger
card.fires_on: Step numbers, bullets, and small linking words in injection instructions, right where the next word would be push or press on the plunger.

modes.label: Step numbers and bullets
modes.description: A step number or bullet that leads into an instruction to push or press the plunger.
modes.example: STEP 1<<4>> Inject the Medication Push on the pl

modes.label: Linking words in injection steps
modes.description: A word like Fully, by, or a comma just before pressing or depressing the plunger.
modes.example: Start the Injection and<< Fully>> Press the White Plunger Slowly push

card.writes: It boosts the word push and its variants, and lowers rect- and harmon- word starts.
card.plain: It fires in injection instructions at the spot where the text is about to say to push the plunger.
